description: Translate the default saved resume-builder document, or the first saved builder document if no default is set, into another language (for example Spanish, French, German, Portuguese or Japanese), ready to send to employers in that market. Returns the new resume's title and a link; the translation is saved as a separate resume and the original stays unchanged. Works from the user's resume on file, or a resume they paste or attach in this chat. Uses the user's AI credits. Do not use it to tailor a resume to a job; use getmattered_optimize_resume, or getmattered_apply, which tailors every application. It also works without a resume-builder document. It uses the resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation (pass its text as resume_text), else the base resume uploaded to their account, else their resume-builder document. In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file.

resume_file.description: In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file. It is downloaded once, right away: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: The resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation, as plain text. Omit it to use the resume already on the user's GetMattered account.

name: getmattered_translate_resume

source.description: pasted / attached: the resume shared in this chat; on_file: the uploaded base resume (ids are document ids); builder: a resume-builder document (ids are builder ids).

translatedContent.description: The translated resume text, when it is ready.

title: Translate Resume
